```{r}
project_root <- normalizePath(
  if (file.exists(file.path("R", "00_config.R"))) "." else "..",
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_root)
```

```{r}
source(file.path("R", "00_config.R"))
load_required_packages(c("dplyr", "readr", "modelsummary", "knitr"))

source_project_script <- function(script) {
  source(script, local = TRUE)
}

model_path <- file.path(paths$intermediate, "main_mundlak_models.rds")
validation_path <- file.path(paths$intermediate, "method_results_validation_summary.csv")
figure_path <- file.path(paths$figures, "figure_1_predicted_probabilities.png")

if (!file.exists(model_path) || !file.exists(validation_path)) {
  source_project_script(file.path("R", "08_validate_against_method_results.R"))
}

if (!file.exists(figure_path)) {
  source_project_script(file.path("R", "06_figure_margins.R"))
}

main_mundlak_fits <- readRDS(model_path)
validation_summary <- readr::read_csv(
  validation_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

render_model_table <- function(fits, title) {
  models <- lapply(fits, `[[`, "model")
  vcovs <- lapply(fits, `[[`, "vcov")
  names(models) <- names(fits)
  names(vcovs) <- names(fits)

  modelsummary::modelsummary(
    models,
    vcov = vcovs,
    stars = TRUE,
    title = title,
    coef_rename = variable_labels,
    coef_omit = "factor\\(year\\)|con$|\\|",
    gof_omit = "AIC|BIC|Log.Lik.|RMSE",
    output = "markdown"
  )
}
```

## Validation Against Method Results

The report uses the fitted model objects produced by the numbered R workflow. The validation script compares selected main-table coefficients and model sample sizes against `Data and Models/6.22/Method_Results.docx`.

```{r}
knitr::kable(validation_summary, digits = 3)
```

## Table 1

```{r}
#| results: asis
render_model_table(
  main_mundlak_fits$table_1,
  "Table 1. Effects of Overrides on Credit Ratings"
)
```
